title: Exact GLM-5.3-Flash SFT/serving qualification packet for Helper (HAR-64)

model.experts: 3 dense MLP layers (0-2) + 42 MoE layers (288 routed top-8 + 1 shared)

decision.recommended_primary: TRL SFTTrainer + PEFT LoRA (attention + dense-MLP + shared-expert targets) on transformers pinned to git commit 770e4c40
decision.recommended_primary_rationale: Helper charter starts with TRL/Transformers/PEFT; the smallest practical pilot envelope; mergeable 2D-linear adapters; no custom training loop
decision.recommended_fallback: NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel full language-backbone SFT (recipe pinned at cb60ebf5), only when multi-node budget exists
rejected: transformers PyPI 5.16.0 wheel: observed AutoConfig ValueError, glm5_next not in CONFIG_MAPPING
Native-FP8-base training: F.linear has no FP8-weight backward; every maintained path dequantizes to BF16
target_modules LoRA on routed experts: they are 3D nn.Parameter tensors, not nn.Linear (upstream modeling_glm5_next.py:117-118)
PEFT target_parameters expert LoRA: peft>=0.20 ParamWrapper exists but unexercised for this architecture, breaks compile, incompatible with quantized base
Unsloth/LLaMA-Factory: no released glm5_next training support (inference/GGUF only)

stack_pins.transformers: git+https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.git@770e4c40d0436082a52dc380f07a9d3f389c99d4 (PR #48342 merged eb4d9e2; 5.16.1+ wheel when released also acceptable)
stack_pins.flash_linear_attention: >=0.4.2 (fla kernels for KDA; pure-torch fallback exists but slow)

trl_consumer_contract.model_load_class: AutoModelForImageTextToText (NOT AutoModelForCausalLM — glm5_next absent from causal-LM mapping; SFTTrainer defaults to CausalLM and will KeyError)
trl_consumer_contract.processing_class: AutoTokenizer (prevents VLM-collator default for text-only traces)
trl_consumer_contract.lora_target_note: KDA projections hit 34 layers; DSA projections hit 11; gate/up/down hit dense layers 0-2 and shared experts 3-44. Routed experts (3D parameters) are untouched.
trl_consumer_contract.assistant_masking: chat_template.jinja has NO {% generation %} tags; assistant_only_loss=True yields zero supervised tokens (verified: verification.json native_assistant_mask.supervised_tokens=0). Use completion_only_loss with prompt-completion records, or a patched template validated to be render-equivalent.

serving.recommended_engine: SGLang purpose-built image lmsysorg/sglang:glm-5.3-flash (support not in a public release; nightly images do NOT work)
serving.hopper_constraints: kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 + dsa tilelang backends; FP8 KV + trtllm DSA disabled on Hopper
serving.dynamic_lora: NOT supported in vLLM or SGLang glm5_next executors; adapters must be merged before serving
serving.merged_bf16_serving_floor: 8x H200 (141GB) or 8x MI300X-class; merged BF16 ~612 GiB exceeds 8x H100 80GB usable VRAM
serving.fp8_serving: 8x H100 serves the native FP8 base; a merged-then-requantized FP8 export is an additional unqualified step

weight_arithmetic_only.note: Raw parameter bytes; excludes KV cache, activations, optimizer, gradients

trl_lora_pilot_floor_estimate.nodes: 1x 8-GPU H200 (1128 GB) or 2x 8-GPU H100 (1280 GB) with FSDP/ZeRO-3
trl_lora_pilot_floor_estimate.basis: BF16 weights 598 GiB + LoRA optimizer ~2 GiB + activation estimate 50-80 GiB at S=4096 B=1 with checkpointing

nemo_full_sft_validated.evidence: NVIDIA docs + recipe YAML; logit parity vs HF within KL 0.00025; NOT terminal-trajectory evidence

costed_qualification_request.purpose: First real GLM-5.3-Flash LoRA pilot on Helper's recipe: forward/backward/save/reload/merge/serve proof at exact target model

option_A_trl_lora_single_node_H200.estimated_hours: 4-8 (weights download ~306 GiB once into volume; 100-300 optimizer steps; save+merge)
option_A_trl_lora_single_node_H200.assumptions: LoRA rank 16; sequences <=4096 tokens; SGLang reload check in same job

costed_qualification_request.next_missing_qualification: A single forward/backward smoke on the pinned git transformers build confirming activation memory fits the chosen node before any multi-hour run

gates.evidence: verification.json: 17/18 checks pass on pinned revision; single failing check is the wheel-vs-source transformers registration gap, resolved by the git pin
Upstream modeling source confirms class, gradient checkpointing, sdpa, 3D expert parameters; no GPU step executed
SGLang purpose-built image + verified H100/H200 cells from official cookbook; merge-before-serve required
No GPU/weights/paid spend authorized by HAR-66; costs above are requests

consumer_requirements_for_har64: Pin transformers to git commit 770e4c40 (or >=5.16.1 wheel when released); never the 5.16.0 wheel.
Instantiate AutoModelForImageTextToText explicitly and pass the object to SFTTrainer; pass AutoTokenizer as processing_class.
Do not use assistant_only_loss with the stock template; use prompt-completion records or a validated patched template.
Decode raw OpenAI function.arguments JSON strings to mappings before template rendering; template rejects raw strings (verified).
Pin clear_thinking and reasoning_effort to the actual rollout settings; OMP xhigh is not a GLM effort setting (falls back to Max).
Define an explicit terminal-stop policy for final assistant targets; the template does not append one.
Merge LoRA before serving; plan the BF16 serving node (H200-class) or a separate re-quantization step.
Publish dataset/config hashes and actual software identities in the training receipt.

proof.cpu_probe: verification.json (probe.py; transformers 5.16.0 wheel; 17/18 pass, registration gap recorded)
proof.scope: No model weights downloaded, no GPU, no paid API calls, no model inference
